name: Skirball Teen Advisory Committee
what_you_do: Teens go to trainings and workshops. They support some public programs at the Skirball. They help with research for the remodel of the permanent collection. Members also get into Skirball events for free.
who_can_apply: Current high school students in grades 10 to 12. The page describes it as an opportunity for Los Angeles teens.
pay_detail: Paid stipend plus community service credit. The amount is not listed.
duration: October 2026 to May 2027, meeting online and in person
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed. The next window is not posted.
how_to_apply: Closed now. Email youthprograms@skirball.org or use the inquiry form on the Skirball youth programs page.
notes: The same page offers TeenTix LA. It is a free pass for teens to visit museums and culture events across Los Angeles (la.teentix.org).
